name: oot_enemy_moblin
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Moblins in Majora's Mask: the spear guard that patrols around its post and charges on sight, and the giant club Moblin whose smash sends a shockwave along the ground. Custom enemies oot.moblin_spear and oot.moblin_club. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
